changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.movements ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, type varchar(10) NOT NULL, value numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, due_date date NOT NULL, status varchar(10) NOT NULL, description text, id_financial_period bigint NOT NULL, id_classification bigint NOT NULL, id_cost_center bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT movements_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT movements_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT ck_movements_on_type CHECK (type IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE')), CONSTRAINT ck_movements_on_status CHECK (status IN ('OPEN', 'PAID')), CONSTRAINT ck_movements_on_value CHECK (value > 0), CONSTRAINT fk_financial_periods_on_movements FOREIGN KEY (id_financial_period) REFERENCES registration.financial_periods (id), CONSTRAINT fk_classifications_on_movements FOREIGN KEY (id_classification) REFERENCES registration.classifications (id), CONSTRAINT fk_cost_centers_on_movements FOREIGN KEY (id_cost_center) REFERENCES registration.cost_centers (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_movements_on_financial_period ON financial.movements (id_financial_period); CREATE INDEX ix_movements_on_status ON financial.movements (status); CREATE INDEX ix_movements_on_due_date ON financial.movements (due_date);

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.payments ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, method varchar(10) NOT NULL, paid_on date NOT NULL, value numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, discount numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, value_paid numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, id_movement bigint NOT NULL, id_wallet bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT payments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT payments_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT payments_id_movement_key UNIQUE (id_movement), CONSTRAINT ck_payments_on_method CHECK (method IN ('WALLET')), CONSTRAINT ck_payments_on_discount CHECK (discount >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_payments_on_value_paid CHECK (value_paid > 0), CONSTRAINT fk_movements_on_payments FOREIGN KEY (id_movement) REFERENCES financial.movements (id), CONSTRAINT fk_wallets_on_payments FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_payments_on_wallet ON financial.payments (id_wallet);

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.wallet_entries ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, direction varchar(6) NOT NULL, origin varchar(12) NOT NULL, value numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, previous_balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, resulting_balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, id_wallet bigint NOT NULL, id_movement bigint, id_financial_period bigint, CONSTRAINT wallet_entries_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT wallet_entries_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_entries_on_direction CHECK (direction IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')), CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_entries_on_origin CHECK (origin IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE', 'REVERSAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_entries_on_value CHECK (value > 0), CONSTRAINT fk_wallets_on_wallet_entries FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id), CONSTRAINT fk_movements_on_wallet_entries FOREIGN KEY (id_movement) REFERENCES financial.movements (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_financial_periods_on_wallet_entries FOREIGN KEY (id_financial_period) REFERENCES registration.financial_periods (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_wallet_entries_on_wallet ON financial.wallet_entries (id_wallet, id); CREATE INDEX ix_wallet_entries_on_movement ON financial.wallet_entries (id_movement); CREATE INDEX ix_wallet_entries_on_financial_period ON financial.wallet_entries (id_financial_period);
